author: More Perfect Union
description:
While publicly demanding the prosecution of crimes committed on Epstein island, Musk is profiting off of sexual exploitation with X’s hyper-sexual chatbots and non-consensual sexual image generation.

When French authorities raided X’s Paris office to investigate, Elon called the move “a political attack.” In response, the French MFA responded: “Maybe that logic flies on some island. Doesn't fly in France.”
title: Elon Musk's Epstein Emails Are Just the Tip of the Iceberg

author: More Perfect Union
description:
Southwest just swapped its most customer-friendly policies for more fees and charges, But it’s not just Southwest. Flying on any airline has gotten worse as a result of deregulation. And options are limited — today just four airlines control 80 percent of the market. Trump's Transportation Secretary says travelers should just "dress up" and "be in a good mood" if they want a better experience. There’s a better, more radical solution that could help: nationalizing the airlines.
